'''Straight Street''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Kerner Plaza/Legends|Kerner Plaza]] ran off this road, as well as the [[Imperial garrison base]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" />
